Concrete defects: (1) `src/policy.rs:89` enforces `require_trace_for_review` only when metadata explicitly sets `requires_review`; a non-mutating critical-risk invocation can reach `review_required` through `critical_always_review` at `src/policy.rs:129` without any trace ID. (2) `src/policy.rs:160` performs lexical prefix target matching, so a path-like target such as `scope/../outside` matches `scope/*`, allowing traversal-shaped targets outside the intended scope unless callers canonicalize them separately. (3) `src/types.rs:74` only checks that `requested_at_utc` is nonblank, so malformed or non-UTC timestamps are accepted while the receipt reports the input as structurally valid. Existing tests do not cover these cases. No files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
